title: Linearization of the unit image into the additive ideal image
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and J contained in I be quasi-coherent ideal sheaves [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers], with I*I contained in J and I contained in the nilradical [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. For K let q_K:Gm_X to (i_K)_*Gm_{Z_K} be restriction of units [def-sc-gm-torsor], and r_K:A_X to (i_K)_*A_{Z_K} be the specified additive restriction [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction]. Then im(ker(q_I) to Gm_X to (i_J)_*Gm_{Z_J}) is isomorphic to im(ker(r_I) to A_X to (i_J)_*A_{Z_J}). All kernels and images are categorical in abelian sheaves, with additive coefficients lifted to the universe of Gm. No module cokernel or quasi-coherence hypothesis on it is involved.

proof.text: Identify the multiplicative image with the pushforward along i_J of the unit restriction kernel for j: Z_I → Z_J. Nilpotence of I supplies the local unit lifting.
Identify the additive image with the pushforward along i_J of the additive restriction kernel for j. This is quotient exactness and needs no nilpotence.

Apply the square-zero relative kernel isomorphism using I*I ≤ J. Map that isomorphism through Etale.lowerStar along J.subschemeι. Compose the multiplicative image isomorphism, this mapped isomorphism, and the inverse of the additive image isomorphism.

theorem nonempty_nilIdealUnitsAdditiveImageIso (X : Scheme.{u})
    (I J : X.IdealSheafData) (hJI : J ≤ I) (hII : I * I ≤ J)
    (hIN : I ≤ X.nilradical) :
    Nonempty (image (kernel.ι (gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf I.subschemeι) ≫
        gmSheafToLowerStarGmSheaf J.subschemeι) ≅
      image (kernel.ι (etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar I.subschemeι) ≫
        etaleAdditiveSheafToLowerStar J.subschemeι))
